errors.text_span: mit einer Tick-Abstände von etwa 12 Monaten
errors.evidence: The tick labels on the x-axis are spaced every 6 months (e.g., Jan. 2015, Jul. 2015, Jan. 2016), not every 12 months.

errors.text_span: Die x-Achse zeigt den Monat, von Januar 2015 bis Januar 2025.
errors.evidence: This information is redundant as the range of the x-axis was already established in the first two sentences.
The line representing 'Realer Mindestlohn' is purple, not red.
The legend entry for this line is 'Realer Mindestlohn, HVPI-basierter Index (Januar 2015 = 100)'. The description incorrectly adds 'Stundenbasis' which belongs to the other legend entries.
In January 2025, the purple line is at an index value of approximately 110, not 105.

The description fails to mention that there are three distinct lines in the plot. It only attempts to describe two, and completely misses the light blue line representing 'Arbeitsproduktivität auf Stundenbasis (Index, 1. Quartal 2015 = 100)'.
All lines in the chart are solid ('durchgezogen'), not dashed ('gestrichelt').

errors.text_span: die bei etwa 95 im Januar 2015 beginnt
errors.evidence: No line starts at 95. The two lines that begin in January 2015 (purple and light blue) both start at the index value of 100.

errors.text_span: Die blaue Linie zeigt einen allgemeinen Abwärtstrend bis Januar 2021
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. The light blue line for 'Arbeitsproduktivität' shows a general upward trend until January 2021. The description mistakenly applies the trend of the purple 'Realer Mindestlohn' line to the blue line.

errors.text_span: erreicht im Januar 2024 einen Höchstwert von etwa 117
errors.evidence: No line reaches a value of 117 at any point. In January 2024, both the purple and dark blue lines are at an approximate value of 110.
